data.title: Comparing Lengths
data.description: Listen to the items and answer out loud to tell whether things are longer or shorter.
data.gradeLevel: elementary students (grades 1-5) - Use age-appropriate vocabulary, concrete examples, structured learning objectives, and interactive elements. Build fundamental understanding.

items.ask: Here is a train, and here is a toy car. Is the train longer or shorter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Any clear spoken response that names the correct menu word.
items.signatureError: Saying shorter because it is a different vehicle.
items.correctionBody: The train is longer because it takes up more space from front to back than the toy car.

actionContract.label: Which Word?
actionContract.instruction: Here is a train, and here is a toy car. Is the train longer or shorter?

items.ask: Here is a crayon, and here is a giant jump rope. Is the crayon longer or shorter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Any clear spoken response that names the correct menu word.
items.signatureError: Saying longer because crayons are fun to use.
items.correctionBody: The crayon is shorter because it does not stretch out as far as the jump rope.

actionContract.label: Which Word?
actionContract.instruction: Here is a crayon, and here is a giant jump rope. Is the crayon longer or shorter?

items.ask: Here is a garden snake, and here is an earthworm. Is the garden snake longer or shorter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Any clear spoken response that names the correct menu word.
items.signatureError: Saying shorter because both are wiggly animals.
items.correctionBody: The garden snake is longer because it stretches out further than the earthworm.

actionContract.label: Which Word?
actionContract.instruction: Here is a garden snake, and here is an earthworm. Is the garden snake longer or shorter?

items.ask: Here is a pencil stub, and here is a brand new ruler. Is the pencil stub longer or shorter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Any clear spoken response that names the correct menu word.
items.signatureError: Saying longer because pencils are for writing.
items.correctionBody: The pencil stub is shorter because it has been used up and has less length than the ruler.
